blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The gap between Vice President Sara Duterte and her predecessor, Leni Robredo, in a hypothetical presidential race has narrowed by 7 percentage points, based on the results of a survey conducted by Octa Research. According to the survey, 40 percent of adult Filipinos said they would vote for Duterte if the May 2028 elections were held today, while 33 percent said they would vote for Robredo. READ: Duterte tops Robredo in hypothetical 2028 presidential race, says Octa Meanwhile, 26 percent of respondents chose neither candidate, were undecided, or did not know whom to support.
